claims.text: The resort is perched on a mountain ridge overlooking the borders of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos.

findings.quote: Perched on a mountain ridge overlooking the borders of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos

claims.text: The resort is set amid 160 acres of bamboo forest in northern Thailand.

findings.quote: set amid 160 acres of bamboo forest in northern Thailand

claims.text: The hotel sits on a sylvan hillside above the Mekong River, an hour north of Chiang Rai.

findings.quote: setting on a sylvan hillside above the Mekong River, an hour north of Chiang Rai

claims.text: The resort has an elephant camp with a scientific research and conservation programme.

findings.quote: Award-winning elephant camp, scientific research and conservation programme

claims.text: All accommodations have balconies and teak floors and are decorated with northern Thai objects and textiles.

findings.quote: The accommodations, all with balconies, have teak floors and are decorated with northern Thai objects and textiles.

claims.text: The Mekong Explorer Suites pay homage to the explorers who charted the Mekong River, blending Lanna traditions with colonial influences.

findings.quote: Mekong Explorer Suite pay homage to the intrepid explorers who charted the Mekong River centuries ago, blending the rich traditions of Lanna with elegant colonial influences.

claims.text: The infinity pool has Mekong views.

findings.quote: The infinity pool has glorious Mekong views

claims.text: The spa offers spa rituals and ancient healing practices inspired by nature.

findings.quote: Indulge in rejuvenating spa rituals and ancient healing practices inspired by nature

claims.text: A sauna, steam rooms and whirlpool are available, and the tennis court can be booked in advance.

findings.quote: Sauna, steam rooms and whirlpool are also available while tennis court can be booked in advance.

claims.text: Guests can drift along the Mekong River as morning mist rises, discovering the cultures and landscapes of three neighbouring countries.

findings.quote: drift along the Mekong River as morning mist rises from its waters, discovering the cultures and landscapes of three neighbouring countries

claims.text: Each Mekong Explorer Tent has its own swimming pool and terrace with panoramic views across the Golden Triangle.

findings.quote: each private tent features its own swimming pool and terrace, with panoramic views across the landscapes of the Golden Triangle.
findings.note: stated on page (Mekong Explorer Tent section)

claims.text: From the room balcony, guests can look over three countries and elephants grazing.

findings.quote: Gaze over three countries and elephants grazing from the comfort of your balcony.

claims.text: The Golden Triangle Asian Elephant Foundation is home to elephants, mahouts and their families, rescued mainly from illegal logging camps, the street or elephant shows.

findings.quote: The Golden Triangle Asian Elephant Foundation (GTAEF) serves as a home for elephants, mahouts and their families - rescued primarily from illegal logging camps, the street, or elephant shows.

claims.text: Guests can journey through the countryside by Royal Enfield sidecar.

findings.quote: journey through the picturesque countryside by Royal Enfield sidecar

claims.text: At Canopy: Treetop Dining, intimate meals are served high among the branches with views over the surrounding wilderness.

findings.quote: Take dining to enchanting heights at Canopy: Treetop Dining, where intimate meals are served high among the branches with spectacular views over the surrounding wilderness.

claims.text: The resort is approximately one hour from Chiang Rai International Airport and a five-minute drive from the historic town of Chiang Saen.

findings.quote: the resort is approximately one hour from Chiang Rai International Airport (CEI) and just a five-minute drive from the historic town of Chiang Saen

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires longer transfers from airports.
